newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares even in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares even in sluggish trade.

text.p: Chilean shares held steady in quiet morning trade, with brokers reporting scant activity due to the U.S. Independence Day holiday.
The blue-chip IPSA index seesawed through the first hour of trade, standing at 136.65 points, up 0.01 percent, at 1040 local time/EDT. The all-share IGPA inched up 0.04 percent to 5848.42 points.

Chilgener slipped 0.3 percent to 171.01 pesos, retreating from recent highs, and Endesa gained 0.31 percent to 322 pesos after it signed a major natural gas deal this week with Argentina's YPF, brokers said.

Brokers reported investors were reluctant to take positions in the market until second quarter earnings start trickling out next week. All quoted companies must report earnings by the end of the month.
